title: lsdir: sorted directory listing
summary: opendir/readdir, skip . and .., collect names and sort them.
hints: `readdir` returns entries in no particular order, so collect the names (strdup!) and sort with `qsort` before printing.
Compare with `strcmp` inside the `qsort` comparison: the elements are `char *` so the callback receives `char **`.
Skip the entries named `.` and `..` only; hidden files like `.hidden` are listed.
